name: print-social-street-photo-with-navy-rounded-cards-fintech
title: Low-angle street portrait with a navy tile and a frosted glass tile carrying fintech slogans
whatItIs: A candid low-angle photo of a woman in a blue cardigan looking at her phone in a station. A solid navy rounded square with 'Spend with more control.' (with italic first word) overlaps the left, and a frosted glass tile with a glossy dollar orb and 'One wallet. More Control.' sits at the right.
whatItMeans: Warm and reassuring; solid and glass tiles show two moods of the same brand.
techniques: Overlay a solid colour tile and a glass tile on one photo.
Italicise one word in a headline.
Colour-match the photo's clothing to the brand navy.
Place a glass orb icon as a small graphic.

vocabulary.definition: A translucent rounded square over a photo.
An opaque colour panel carrying text.
Setting the opening word in italic for contrast.
Clothing chosen to echo brand colours.
